title: Fraud monitoring console
summary: An IBM Carbon operations dashboard: live transactions, risk scores and an alert queue.
ideas: Add a velocity rule: flag three payments from different cities within an hour
Add an analyst notes box and a case history to the alert detail panel
Show a heat-grid of risk by hour of day using plain CSS blocks
Add a 'false positive' button that lowers a rule's weight, and show how precision changes
guide: UI uses IBM Carbon ('@carbon/react', dark g100 theme, precompiled CSS; no Sass). Files: src/App.jsx (layout, tabs, live feed timer), src/risk.js (explainable rules with weights, scoring, toggles), src/data.js (transaction generator, fake data only), src/components/Kpis.jsx, TransactionTable.jsx (plain Carbon table parts with own sorting; avoid DataTable with live data), CaseModal.jsx (alert detail with reasons and Approve/Block), RulesPanel.jsx (switch rules on and off and watch scores change). Import Carbon icons one at a time (e.g. import Warning from '@carbon/icons-react/es/Warning.js', PascalCase file name, then <Warning size={16} />) to keep dev start fast. This pack has no Tailwind: style with Carbon components and inline styles or a small src/app.css.
